$meta.title: Supplementary golden set: the documents the main bench could not sample.
$meta.why_not: There is no before. These documents had no addressable structure before the parser fix, so no probe could be cut from them and no rule could be missed. A before/after pair here would be a number with nothing behind it.
$meta.what_it_measures: Whether a document the parser could not reach yields normative statements once it can. The five protocols with zero rules in the main bench are here for that reason, plus every other ingested document outside the main set, so the answer is not five data points.
$meta.labelling: Identical to eval/golden.json, and the functions are shared: eval/lib/labelling.mjs.
